description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and an unspecified metric, comparing four different categories: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens," has a linear scale, ranges from 200 to 900, and is marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis is unlabeled, has a linear scale, ranges from 10 to 40, and is marked at intervals of 10. The blue line representing Tutorials starts at approximately 22 on the y-axis at 200 tokens, increases to around 30 at 800 tokens, and then slightly decreases to about 29 at 900 tokens. The red line for Library Documentation begins at roughly 26 at 200 tokens, rises to approximately 32 at 800 tokens, and then drops to around 29 at 900 tokens. The yellow line for StackOverflow posts starts at about 32 at 200 tokens, sharply declines to around 14 at 900 tokens. The green line for Github files begins at approximately 29 at 200 tokens, increases to around 32 at 800 tokens, and then decreases to about 30 at 900 tokens.
